description: Shell script for testing CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversion and line ending normalization in a Git repository. Contains functions for creating gitattributes, comparing files, and performing various tests on line ending conversions under different configurations.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming line endings, checks for differences.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with special transformations for whitespace and line endings.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Creates sets of test files with different line endings and attributes.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks for expected warning messages related to line ending conversions.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs commits with specific attributes and checks for warnings.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up and commits files with various line ending configurations, checking warnings.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and checks for warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string representing the line ending type for display.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts attribute settings into a human-readable string.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Verifies that files in the repository match expected line ending states.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks specific files in the repository against expected line ending states.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Tests checkout behavior with various line ending and attribute configurations.
